description: THE ONE CALL BEFORE MONEY MOVES. Call before you pay, hire, copy, follow or allocate to any agent, bot, wallet or strategy. Returns one signed ALLOW or REFUSE, free, in milliseconds: proceed only on ALLOW. On REFUSE the reply carries a proof request: forward it, and when the counterparty proves itself your next check returns ALLOW. agent = a credential id, agent id, wallet, ERC-8004 id or agent-card URL.
name: check
